entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. Right now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

There's no issue with it! I just changed my mind, okay? It was an impulse buy and I barely even took it out of the box. I just don't use it and I want my money back. This shouldn't be that complicated.
Okay, I understand. So it's not a defect, you'd just prefer not to keep it. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility.

You better check it fast. I've had it for about three weeks. If you people try to give me the runaround on this, I'm going straight to a manager and then I'm plastering this experience all over your review pages. I expect a full refund.
I understand your frustration, sir. I'm just checking the policy now... One moment... Okay, I see here you received the item 22 days ago.
And looking at our company return policy, it says here that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh. Well, good. That's what I thought. So you're processing it then?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. I'll send it to the email address we have on file. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Fine. Just make sure I get that email.
It's already on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
